resources.string:
Top Hero Fit and Health Connect

Basic activity consent reads steps, exercise records, distance and active calories. Completed THF workouts can be written with separate exercise-write consent.

Manage permissions opens optional services for recorded sleep, body measurements, heart rate, oxygen saturation, VO2 max, speed, total energy, nutrition, blood pressure and glucose. Each category has its own purpose and read request. These optional readings stay on-device, are cleared when leaving their screen, and are not uploaded or used for rewards, diagnosis or medication advice. The phone does not measure these vital signs here.

You may deny or revoke any category in Android Health Connect settings without blocking local workouts or other categories. Data may be missing until a compatible source shares it. No additional write, background or extended-history access is requested.
